## Gradual typing

Type hints are optional and not enforced at runtime, but tools like **mypy**/**pyright** check them. They document intent and catch bugs.

## Modern syntax

Use builtin generics (`list[int]`, `dict[str, int]`), `X | None` unions, and PEP 695 type parameters (`def first[T](xs: list[T]) -> T`).

## Protocols

`typing.Protocol` gives structural (duck) typing you can type-check — accept anything with the right shape.
